definitions.explanation: A line that curves up and down in a wave-like pattern. Used in documents, diagrams, and proofreading marks.

examples.japanese: {波線|なみせん}で{囲|かこ}んでください。
examples.english: Please circle it with a wavy line.

examples.japanese: {重要|じゅうよう}な{部分|ぶぶん}に{波線|なみせん}を{引|ひ}いた。
examples.english: I drew a wavy line under the important parts.

examples.japanese: グラフの{中|なか}で{波線|なみせん}は{省略|しょうりゃく}を{意味|いみ}している。
examples.english: The wavy line in the graph indicates an omission.

notes:
USAGE:
In graphs and charts, a {波線|なみせん} on an axis indicates that part of the scale has been omitted. In proofreading and note-taking, wavy underlines are used to highlight important passages. The tilde character (~) is also sometimes called {波線|なみせん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {波線|なみせん}を{引|ひ}く (to draw a wavy line)
- {波線|なみせん}で{囲|かこ}む (to enclose with a wavy line)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {点線|てんせん}: dotted line
- {実線|じっせん}: solid line
- {直線|ちょくせん}: straight line
